axis_x.sign_channel: hard predicted DRS + exact DEP + exact GAPQ + exact PCD; balanced sign BCE
axis_x.order_channel: smooth boundary DRS + exact DEP + exact GAPQ + smooth PCD; symmetric SmoothL1

axis_y.name: BC-NAP
axis_y.exact_materiality_rule: outside +/- positive_gain, exact native relative recovery value owns sign
axis_y.equivalence_rule: inside the materiality band, smooth native relative recovery value owns local order

near.development_joint_sign_floor: at least 4/19 and no ranking collapse relative to v48.50-A

stop_rules: Do not tune MC-NCP, exact-only NAP, old hard-magnitude DEFC, threshold grids, proposal top-k, resampling, or regime routers.
If BC-FC repeats v48.50-B safe-positive DRS veto/ranking collapse, audit predicted-root calibration and teacher/native component correctness instead of tuning loss temperature/weight.
If BC-NAP cannot preserve Near ranking while lifting Contact sign, stop admission-transport variants and audit teacher PCD, DEP/GAP normalization, and root/recovery witness calibration.
If B and C are individually positive but D has strong negative interaction, audit shared margin-head gradient conflict before adding capacity.
